info.name: Retrieves attachment metadata for a short message document.

params.name: workspaceID
params.description: The Artifact ID of the workspace containing the documents for short message viewer.

params.name: documentID
params.description: The Artifact ID of the short message document.

items.docs: Returns attachment records for the attachment identifiers supplied in the request body.

info.name: Retrieves entity information for one or more short message participants.

params.name: workspaceID
params.description: The Artifact ID of the workspace containing the documents for short message viewer.

items.docs: Participant lookups use participant identity details from the request body and return mapped entity details.

info.name: Retrieves the JSON representation of a short message conversation document.

params.name: workspaceID
params.description: The Artifact ID of the workspace containing the documents for short message viewer.

params.name: documentID
params.description: The Artifact ID of the document for short message viewer.

items.docs: The JSON structure aligns with RSMF manifest-style payloads used by the short message viewer.

info.name: Requests creation of a new short message document from a subset of events.

params.name: workspaceID
params.description: The Artifact ID of the workspace containing the document to be sliced.

params.name: documentID
params.description: The Artifact ID of the document to be sliced.

items.docs: This operation queues slicing work and supports options such as attachment creation and participant preservation.

info.name: Validates whether the specified short message document contains a valid RSMF payload.

params.name: workspaceID
params.description: The Artifact ID of the workspace containing the documents for short message viewer.

params.name: documentID
params.description: The Artifact ID of the short message document.

items.docs: Returns validation status and diagnostic details for document-level RSMF validation.
